runs.name: rank
runs.input:
Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here. No reply needed.
Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days
Please send the signed quote by 5 pm today
runs.output:
Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay
Please send the signed quote by 5 pm today
Reminder: your invoice is due in 30 days
Newsletter: our autumn catalog is here. No reply needed.
runs.see: The outage comes first and the quote due today second. The bill due in a month comes third, and the newsletter that needs no reply comes last.

runs.name: rank-jsonl
runs.command: thinkthen rank 'Does this stop customers from buying?' --jsonl --field /title --top 1 < bugs.jsonl
runs.see: The checkout crash stops customers from buying, so B-2 comes back first, id and all.
